primaryChecks.text: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
primaryChecks.previousContext: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
primaryChecks.nextContext: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
